meta.title: x/tools/gopls: diagnostics doesn't update when build tags specification changes
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@6422c5c8c7ed (internal/lsp/cache: invalidate metadata on magic comment changes; CL 296549)
meta.build_notes: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@<version> with the local Go (go1.27.1), which builds both; the server runs the local go command, which still honors '// +build' lines (checked: go list puts foo.go in IgnoredGoFiles). Reported 2020-04-28 (go1.14.1, gopls master); v0.6.6 was tagged 2021-02-22, the fix merged 2021-03-02, v0.6.7 was tagged 2021-03-10.
meta.notes: Removing a build constraint changes the file set of the package, but gopls re-ran go list only for import changes, so bar.go kept 'undefined: Foo'. The fix invalidates metadata when a file's magic comments (build constraints) change.

files.source: issue body, pre block, section '--- foo/foo.go ---'
issue body, pre block, section '--- foo/bar.go ---'

files.note: the module root is the directory foo of the txtar (the reporter's log loads package_path "foo" from /Users/hakim/scratch/foo with GOMOD=.../foo/go.mod), so the two files sit at the root of module foo; go 1.14, the reporter's Go

repro.steps: Open foo.go and bar.go: foo.go is excluded by '// +build foo', so bar.go reports 'undefined: Foo'. Remove the build-tag line from foo.go (line 0) and save foo.go. Reported: the diagnostics on bar.go remain. Probe: the diagnostics of bar.go after the edit are compared with a fresh session on the edited files and a fresh control.
